description: Source code implementing ObliviousHttpResponse class for handling encryption, decryption, and serialization of HTTP responses in the oblivious HTTP protocol, including cryptographic operations with HPKE and AEAD.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpResponse
classes.description: Handles encryption, decryption, serialization, and cryptographic operations for oblivious HTTP responses.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpResponse::CreateClientObliviousResponse
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP response on the client side by decrypting received data.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpResponse::CreateServerObliviousResponse
methods.description: Creates an oblivious HTTP response on the server side by encrypting plaintext payload.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpResponse::EncapsulateAndSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the encrypted response data for transmission.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpResponse::GetCommonAeadParams
methods.description: Retrieves AEAD parameters based on the HPKE context.

methods.name: ObliviousHttpResponse::CommonOperationsToEncapDecap
methods.description: Performs common cryptographic operations for key and nonce derivation used in response encryption/decryption.
